text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. I'd like to buy those beans
and some
fresh milk, pl—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
You've got quite the eye for quality
beans, miss!
text_block_list.name: Store Employee

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I heard you carry very
high-quality goods
here.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello, Trainer! Not exactly... I need
them for
Grandmother's special sweet
bean soup.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It's something she used to make for me
when I was
sick in bed.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
If I close my eyes, I can still recall its
gentle
warmth... I want to try and
replicate that flavor
myself.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: I'd love to try it too.

text_block_list.text: Wh-what? You?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Not that I mind, but... W-well...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: N-no, that's not it at all!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
This is a rare opportunity for you to
taste a dish
from the esteemed Mejiro
family. I will do my best
to make sure it
is worthy of the name!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I've been given permission to use the
cafeteria
kitchen. My preparations are
complete. Now...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
J-just a moment! Let's see... According
to what
Grandmother taught me...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
That's right! The beans! The first thing is
to
simmer the beans! I remember it
perfectly!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer. May I ask you a question?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: How does one… "simmer" something?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
O-oh, nothing! Never mind! What I
meant to say
was, well... Umm...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I have a confession to make. I'm still learning how to cook, you see...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I don't think I can replicate the dish
faithfully.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: I can lend you a hand.

text_block_list.text:
Really? I feel guilty after promising to
make it for
you, but... I'd gladly accept
your help!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The first thing to do is to explain what
simmering
is.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I see, low heat to make the mixture
bubble. I shall
begin at once!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me. How low should the heat be, exactly?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
And so, Мэдзиро МакКуин struggles
through the
unfamiliar art of cooking...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's finished! Hehe, the sweet fragrance
of the milk
matches my childhood
memories to a T!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. But of course I did. Recreating

Grandmother's cooking calls for nothing
short of
my best.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
And... I also have you to thank for
assisting me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Therefore, as a sign of my gratitude, I
shall let
you have the first taste. Go
ahead, try it while it's
still warm.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Let's take our time and enjoy it together.

text_block_list.text:
Grandmother once said something very
similar a
long time ago...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
She told me the best thing for a cold
was to eat
this soup together. And she
was right. I forgot all
about how sick I
was.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Making good memories from difficult
times...
That's what this recipe means to
me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Let's make some new memories together.

text_block_list.text: Yes, let's. Now, without further ado...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Take care not to burn yourself drinking
it that
fast!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Is that so? ...Hehe, I'm glad. I'm not yet

accustomed to cooking, so hearing that
is a relief.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
From now on, this dish will always
remind me of
spending time together
with you as well.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Our first time cooking together has
turned out to
be a rousing success.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин and I eat the milky
white soup
together. The flavor is
exquisite.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
